title: Car insurance renewal confirmed
text:
Rang Harbourline about the car insurance renewal and they matched the cheaper comparison quote after ten minutes on hold. The renewal is now confirmed at 568 pounds for the year, with the same excess and windscreen cover, starting on 14 November.

The no-claims certificate and the dashcam discount code were applied on the call. Paying by annual card payment; the new policy schedule should arrive by email within five days.

No need to switch insurer this year. Turn off the comparison site price alerts.

title: Kitchen renovation revised quote approved
text:
Brightwell sent the revised kitchen renovation quote after we chose quartz worktops and added the two extra sockets for the island. The final figure is 17,850 pounds, still without appliances.

We approved it and paid the 10 percent deposit. Start date confirmed for 20 April, four weeks of work, and they will now arrange the electrical certificate as well.

Order the appliances separately so they arrive in the third week, and clear the kitchen cupboards the weekend before.

title: Cornwall holiday budget (draft)
text:
Draft budget for the Cornwall week in August. Rough figures only until we book.

Cottage near St Ives for seven nights: estimate 1,450 pounds. Fuel and parking about 180. Food and eating out 450. Surf lessons for the children 120. Days out, including the Eden Project, 100.

Draft total 2,300 pounds. The holiday pot should cover it by July if we keep moving 300 a month into it.

Still to decide: take Biscuit with us or book kennels.

title: Cornwall holiday budget (final, booked)
text:
Booked the Cornwall cottage near St Ives for 15 to 22 August. The final price was 1,620 pounds because we went for the dog-friendly cottage, but it means Biscuit comes with us and no kennels.

Final budget: cottage 1,620, fuel and parking 190, food and eating out 450, surf lessons 120, days out 100. Total 2,480 pounds.

The 400 pound deposit is paid and the balance is due on 1 August. Check-in is from 4pm; the key safe code comes by text the day before.

title: Flat rent review 2025
text:
Hartley Lettings sent their initial proposal for the rent review on the flat on Carrow Road: 950 pounds a month from 1 November 2025, up from 900, in line with similar two-bedroom flats nearby.

The tenant, Mr Doyle, has been reliable and always pays on time, so a modest rise feels fair rather than pushing to the top of the range.

The agent's fee for the renewal paperwork is 60 pounds. Reply to Hartley Lettings by the end of September.

title: Flat rent review 2026 confirmed
text:
Hartley Lettings confirmed this year's rent review for the flat on Carrow Road. Mr Doyle has agreed and signed the renewal, so the new rent is 1,010 pounds a month from 1 December 2026, replacing last year's figure.

The agent fee for the renewal is 75 pounds, which goes on the tax return as a letting expense. The next inspection is booked for January.

Update the rental income spreadsheet and check the first payment arrives at the new amount.

title: Parents evening booking - autumn
text:
School booking system: the initial slot for Maya's autumn parents evening with Ms Okafor is Thursday 5 November at 17:40, ten minutes, in the Year 5 classroom.

Things to raise: how she is settling into the new class, whether she joined the debate club, and if the times tables practice is paying off.

Leo's slot still needs booking before the system closes.

title: Parents evening rescheduled - confirmed
text:
Ms Okafor is away on a training course that week, so the school has moved Maya's parents evening appointment. Confirmed new slot: Tuesday 10 November at 18:10, same classroom, still ten minutes.

Dad can't make the new time, so I will go on my own. Bring Maya's reading record and the note about the debate club, and ask about booking Leo's slot on the same evening if there is space.

title: Power flush quote for the heating
text:
Following the engineer's advice after the boiler breakdown, asked Hearthside Heating to quote for a power flush of the central heating.

Initial estimate: 420 pounds for eleven radiators, including fitting a magnetic filter. Proposed date 6 November.

They think the upstairs radiators being cold at the top points to sludge. The job takes most of a day and the heating is off throughout.

title: Power flush booked - revised quote
text:
Hearthside Heating revised the power flush quote after their site visit: 365 pounds, because a magnetic filter is already fitted under the boiler.

Booked and confirmed for Thursday 12 November, arriving at 8am. Clear access to the boiler cupboard and every radiator the night before.

Payment on completion by bank transfer. Bleed the radiators afterwards and check the pressure gauge is back to 1.5 bar.

title: Greenfield Allotment Society newsletter - November
text:

The autumn work party is on Saturday 28 November from 10am to clear the communal compost bays. Bring gloves and a flask; soup provided.

Bonfires are only allowed in November and December, and never on Sundays.

Best wishes, The Committee

title: Sloe gin recipe (web clipping)
text:
Sloe gin. Pick sloes after the first frost, or freeze them overnight to split the skins.

Put 450 g of sloes and 250 g of caster sugar into a large sterilised jar and pour over a 1 litre bottle of gin. Seal and shake every day for the first week, then once a week.

Leave in a cool dark cupboard for at least three months before straining through muslin. Ready in time for Christmas if started in early October.
